claim_text: Fatigue alone does not establish iron deficiency or anemia, and the bisglycinate form does not remove the need for appropriate clinical assessment and laboratory confirmation where indicated.
health_goal_or_outcome: Support safe, indication-specific recommendations and avoid unsupported supplementation.

population.other_context: People reporting fatigue and considering iron bisglycinate.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Relevant dietary and supplemental forms; verify exact product label and formulation.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Iron Health Professional Fact Sheet describes deficiency and reference information.
limitations: No iron dose from symptom alone; excess iron can be harmful.
Exact source passages and underlying evidence require full appraisal before approval.
